changelog: The Building Editor rebuilt light (Joshua's snapshot design). (1) Opening a building no longer loads its whole zone: the editor downloads a light list, the zone's basic shape, and just that building's page of details — opening Elizabeth Baptist Church now downloads about 1 MB instead of the whole zone and answers in a fraction of a second, and the freeze is gone (the street-facing measurement only looks at nearby streets, with the same answer as before). (2) The properties pane scrolls properly: the mouse wheel now scrolls the pane everywhere, never changes a drop-down by accident, and the scrollbar is always shown. (3) Saving proves itself: after pushing, the editor closes the connection, re-downloads on a fresh one, and only says 'saved' when the bytes that come back contain your change — a colour edit is the tested case, and a save with no changes now honestly says so once. (4) Design drop-down lists (wall materials, roof textures, window and door types, and the rest) now download from the repo's stock shelf instead of being baked into the app; if a list cannot be downloaded and no earlier copy is cached, the editor says the list is unavailable rather than inventing one. (5) Flagged buildings lock properly: the flagged list holds 1,532 buildings and all 1,532 now lock (the old matching missed most of them on odd-shaped footprints — the church included). (6) New: a Draw for Mollie tab — sketch with finger or mouse (five colours, four line sizes, free/straight/curve lines, eraser, undo) and Send files it to the repo's drawings folder, verified the same way saves are.
